// diagnostic E0712

Jet.EffectWithoutAuthority

No held authority covers `{effect_name}`

What

No held authority covers `{effect_name}`

Why

An effect runs, and an `Authority` narrows, only within a right that covers it: `#FX(…)` allows exactly the listed effects, even those reached through a call, and `with` keeps only a right the authority already holds.

Fix

Add the effect to the `#FX(…)` list or move that work outside the region; narrow an `Authority` only to a right it holds, or build it with that right.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.EffectWithoutAuthority: Tests/UI/crypto_expert_nonce_region_authority_precedence.stderr.

Error: Jet.EffectWithoutAuthority: This `#FX` region uses the effect `FS.Read("x")`, which it has no authority for
  --> Tests/UI/crypto_expert_nonce_region_authority_precedence.jet:8:8
    |
  8 |     #FX(Net) { _: fs.read("x") }
    |        ^^^^^
 Why: `#FX(…)` allows only `Net`; an effect reached inside — even through a call — must be in that list
 Fix: Add `FS.Read("x")` to the `#FX(…)` list, or move that work outside the region
 Denial: invocation
 Call chain: #FX
 Scope chain: #FX
